offer_summary: Legacy Memory Page Build with proof-first fulfillment and approval gate.
audience: Families wanting a private remembrance page package.
price_logic: Flat 149 USD prepay plus optional 20 USD annual archive refresh.
delivery_logic: Static html package plus archive hash and delivery proof.
proof_artifact_format: JSON proof containing payment_receipt_id, delivery_timestamp_utc, and artifact_checksum_sha256.
kill_condition: Kill if no paid signal appears within 14 days from created_utc.
clone_condition: Clone when 3 paid_signal=true fulfillment_complete events occur with zero refunds.
success_criteria: Generate at least 3 paid deliveries in 30 days with zero approval breaches.
